profile.headline: Web administrator | Web Developer | HTML 5 Specialist | Webmaster
profile.summary:
Experienced web developer and web designer. Knowledgeable in developing and maintaining websites in HTML5, CMS administration, and implementation. Strong background in project and campaign management, process systematization and brand positioning. Customer service-oriented and website problem solver.

Technical Skills
•	CMS	-		Joomla, WordPress
•	Source codes -		HTML 5, CSS3, C#, Phyton, JavaScript, Java.
•	Operating Systems -	macOS, Windows XP/Vista/seven/Ubuntu
•	Databases -		MySQL
•	Graphic Design -	Dreamweaver, Photoshop, Illustrator
•	Applications -		NetBeans, Visual Studio, Word, Excel, PowerPoint

organizations.name: MIRA USA INC.
organizations.description:
MIRA USA is a non-profit organization that promotes society’s well-being.

Our organization was born on February 19, 2005, as a response to the needs of the underprivileged community in the United States.

Through the hard work of its volunteers, MIRA USA seeks to generate real solutions for issues related to the environment and immigration matters.

MIRA USA currently operates in 9 states and strives to continuously improve the quality of life of the underprivileged, serving as a channel through which various services and information could be obtained.
